context: Asuka lectures on Earth across centuries.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: science lecture; nature/era vocabulary (地球/世紀/脳/身体/知れ) in natural home.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 地球は、長い世紀を経て変わってきました。
lines.en: Earth has changed over long centuries.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured informative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 人の身体も、変わったんですか?
lines.en: Did the human body change too?
lines.style: curious teen boy voice, soft warm earnest engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 身体も脳も、少しずつ変化しました。
lines.en: Both body and brain changed little by little.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured informative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 脳は、どれくらい賢くなったんですか?
lines.en: How much smarter did the brain get?
lines.style: engaged teen boy voice, soft warm curious throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 脳が発達し、多くを知れるようになりました。
lines.en: The brain developed and came to know much.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured informative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 次の世紀は、どうなるんでしょう?
lines.en: What will the next century be like?
lines.style: thoughtful teen boy voice, soft warm curious throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 地球の未来は、私たち次第ですよ。
lines.style: warm teacher voice, soft warm measured clarity throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 身体も脳も、大切にしなきゃですね。
lines.en: We have to take care of both body and brain.
lines.style: moved teen boy voice, soft warm realization throughout
